_about: Config for .github/scripts/{build,check,smoke}_release_tree.py (#851). The `release` branch is what the Anthropic plugin directory fetches; main keeps everything. See docs/releasing.md.
_deny_why: Deny-list, not allow-list: a path forgotten here ships and is caught loudly by the size/count check; a path forgotten in an allow-list would vanish from users' installs silently. Entry ending in '/' = directory prefix, otherwise an exact path.
_budget_why: max_file_bytes and max_files are the directory's own rules (pre-submission checklist, 'Files in the plugin folder'); images and fonts are exempt from the per-file limit. max_total_bytes (3 MiB) is this repo's own ceiling: the directory timed out validating 9.2 MB.
_release_readme_why: README.release.md (#898) swaps in for README.md in the release tree only: no $VAR/${...}, no network command names, minimal URLs -- the full README with every disclosure detail stays on main. CHANGELOG.md is no longer shipped at all (on the deny-list above): only README and LICENSE are required by the directory.
_smoke_why: smoke_release_tree.py defaults (DROP_PREFIXES, the fake claude/codex binaries and the env vars that name them) used to be hard-coded; another repo reusing this tooling only edits this block (#866).
_cli_version_why: Pinned >= 2.1.281: earlier versions warn 'Unknown field' on the directory listing fields (documentationUrl, supportUrl, privacyPolicyUrl, termsOfServiceUrl, icon) in plugin.json, and --strict turns that warning into a failure (#866).
